event_name: Dodge NHRA Great Lakes Nationals presented by MOPAR

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 63 degrees, relative humidity 66 percent, barometer 30.14 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,316 feet, track 
temperature 92 degrees.

His win in Rd. 2 was Doug Kalitta's 47th holeshot win.
 
In the 54 races between Kalitta and Langdon Shawn has "left first" 38 times 

Langdon is 32 - 22 against Kalitta in prior events. 

Kalitta with a great light, but shook and clicked it off early.

Langdon launched hard and kept it hooked up for the win.  He makes the fastest pass in the history of
the sport for the win.  

Shawn Langdon's incremental times: 60ft-0.837 sec., 330ft-2.113, 660ft-2.955/301.41 mph.

Spencer Massey is 30 - 30 in Rd. 3 races.

This is the first time Massey and Stewart have faced each other in eliminations. 

Stewart with the starting line advantage, but was up in smoke right at the hit and pedaled it before
he clicked it off.

Massey was on a good pass until the engine let go on the top end.  He coast to the win.  He will give
up lane choice to Langdon in the final.
